explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says that one fiber, `Y ↦ particularSource x l j n (p, Y)`, of the library's own `particularSource` is continuous. Its mathematical content comes from the library's lemma `particularSource_smooth`. The proof then only uses general Mathlib glue: `ContinuousOn.comp`, `continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id` and `continuousOn_univ`. These amount to the general fact that a map continuous on a set containing the slice {p} × univ has a continuous fiber there. That kind of general principle applied to the library's own definitions does not count, so no Mathlib declaration carries this theorem's content.
